secrets.name: VAF_GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key (console.groq.com/keys). The shipped default text model is groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile, so without it the Brief and Script phases cannot run.

secrets.name: VAF_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
secrets.description: ElevenLabs API key (elevenlabs.io -> profile -> API keys). The shipped default voice provider is ElevenLabs; without it the Voice phase cannot run.

secrets.name: VAF_GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional Google Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) for Gemini text and image generation.

secrets.name: VAF_OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com/api-keys) for OpenAI image generation.
